handoffs.quote: Oleg the Red (1252-1258): 'ruled as their vassal and died as a monk'; Roman III (1258-1270): 'ruled as Mongol vassal but executed for his faith.'

Ivan III (1427-1456): 'renounced his allegiance to Golden Horde'; 'In 1380, Oleg II did not take part in the Battle of Kulikovo, although he was an ally of Mamai.' The end year is this dossier's (the page dates no formal end).
'the duchy became an Imperial State of the Holy Roman Empire'; Vladivoj 'received Bohemia as a fief from the hands of the East Frankish king Henry II in 1002'.

Moravia 'was variously a de facto independent state, and also subject to the Duchy, later the Kingdom of Bohemia'; Conrad II Otto: 'united with Bohemia 1189-1197'; 'In 1182, the Margraviate was created at the behest of Emperor Frederick Barbarossa'.
Infobox: 'State of the Holy Roman Empire (from 962)'; 1180: 'Welfs deposed and Ascanians enfeoffed with a "severely belittled duchy"'. Extends the existing row 962-1177.

Same infobox line; 'The infobox lists John I and Albert II co-rulers: 1260'; 'Definite partition into Saxe-Lauenburg and Saxe-Wittenberg: 1296'. Follows the pattern of the kingdom-of-bohemia rows (Empire to 1259, Minor States umbrella from 1260).
